items.title: Build the isolated closeout-integrity characterization harness and current-main baseline manifest
items.context: Provide temporary repositories, structured F1-F7 results, expected-pre-fix versus desired-state semantics, and zero checkout pollution.

items.title: Characterize workspace authority and validation persistence defects F1-F2
items.context: Reproduce environment-root/worktree divergence and clean text-versus-JSON canonical evidence asymmetry with controls for already-correct validation branches.

items.title: Characterize convergence and terminal DONE ordering defects F3-F4
items.context: Record current post-TEST duplicate accounting/reuse behavior and prove the phase-before-real-merge partial-DONE risk without mutating the developer checkout.

items.title: Characterize boundary labels, scope paths, and shrinkage roll-up defects F5-F7
items.context: Prove TEST-to-DONE mislabeling, existence-dependent uv.lock identity, and effective-scope disagreement between coverage and parent roll-up.

items.title: Wire the non-blocking characterization command and publish the refreshed baseline
items.context: Add an explicit npm entrypoint, map every probe to its M1-M6 inversion owner, update the closeout plan to CLI 0.3.249/current-main status, and keep known faulty behavior out of blocking routine validation.

items.title: Prove the characterization baseline is deterministic across fresh isolated runs
items.context: Bind the baseline to exact git HEAD and CLI version, then require two newly created temporary repositories to produce identical F1-F7 statuses, structured reason codes, control outcomes, and checkout-cleanliness results, addressing the product-reviewer INIT advisory.
items.userSees: The characterization report names the current HEAD and CLI version and shows two identical isolated-run result sets.
